_comment: Physical positions for objects the TurtleBot can reach. Distances in cm, angles in degrees, in the bot's local frame (origin = pose at localization start). 'visual_servo' flag controls whether the final approach uses the camera (red mask) — set false for non-red targets so the bot doesn't hang waiting to see red.
_comment_task1: Task 1 (TB_BallToDroneBasket_Setpoint) addresses the payload as ball(300) and the drone's basket as basket(700). POSITIONS BELOW ARE PLACEHOLDERS — set them to where the ball and the parked drone actually are before running on hardware.
